answer: Rotating Echo Assignment. Each epoch, a public verifiable random function derives a per-agent challenge from a seed no one can precompute, and agents must answer it within a short window. A sybil cluster must run every identity through the full challenge each round, so its cost scales linearly with fleet size while honest agents pay once. The seed’s unpredictability caps precomputation at the river of fresh entropy, and any missed round drops an identity below the zenith threshold for rewards.
